correctness.rationale: For any irreducible real 2x2 A with bc≠0, positive diagonal similarity scales b↦bs and c↦c/s. Left/right eigenvectors for each simple λ give χ² proportional to (|b|²s²+|τ|²)(|c|²/s²+|τ|²); AM-GM yields a common unique minimum at s²=|c/b|, precisely row/column 2-norm balance. For B_t (t>0) opposite off-diagonal absolute values match, so B_t is balanced; its spectrum is {1,2t+1,2t+2}. With D_t=diag(1,1,sqrt(2t+1)), A_t=D_t B_t D_t^-1 has χ_A=(2t+3)/(2t+1), χ_B=sqrt(3(4t²+4t+3))/(2t+1), hence squared difference 8t²/(2t+1)²>0, damage tending sqrt3. Frobenius squared norm difference 8t²/(2t+1)>0. Independently symbolically verified char polynomial, eigenvector identities and all rational comparisons; theorem only for exact balancing.
